title: Card fraud
note: REAL data — fraud=1. Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB Machine Learning Group / Worldline) — ODbL 1.0 (database) / DbCL 1.0 (contents): real card transactions by European cardholders over two days in September 2013; for confidentiality the original fields were released only as PCA components V1–V28 (plus Time and Amount). Held-out = by time, case mix 10.00% positive (population 0.17%); grown only on the training split. Contains information from the Credit Card Fraud Detection database (ULB Machine Learning Group / Worldline), which is made available here under the Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0.
lineage: Grown by tools/build-real-brains.mjs with src/grow.mjs growPattern — the seed-library ribosome (sjgant80-hub/seed-library, vendored) — on the training split only, graded once on the held-out split. Pattern shape and answer path: the Konomi SLM (sjgant80-hub/konomi-slm). Konomi architecture: Thomas Frumkin.
